decision.reasoning_trace: I evaluated several high-quality options including the Sony SRS-XB43 and the Harman Kardon Onyx 6. While the Harman Kardon is available in black, it is a bit bulkier and heavier than I would like for my specific travel needs. The Sony speaker has the performance and features I am looking for, but it is only available in blue in this feed, and the JBL Clip is an older generation model (Clip 3) in a dusty pink color that does not match my preference. The Rerii retro speaker and DOSS Soundbox are interesting mid-tier options but do not quite meet my requirements for a primary audio device. Given these specific color, model generation, and portability tradeoffs, I have decided to wait for a restock of different colorways or the latest models.
